My dear Mary
I came home from Salisbury yesterday afternoon, and tried to answer your note, but could not finish. I will keep your card and see if I can give the case a vote.
I am going to stay with [Frances](/person/1604) next week from Monday to Saturday
Your affectionate

C M Yonge


[^1]: Dated on the assumption that it post-dates Frances Yonge’s move to 70 Kensington Gardens Square in 1892.
